card.title: What Really Happened?
card.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

mechanism: A compares apparently conflicting times, accepts a reconciliation, then tests the bag's next movement.
confusable: Unlike hostile contradiction hunting, A must update when details fit and continue testing the account.
comparison: The bus/coffee sequence can reconcile two accounts; the alternative tests physical container descriptions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
